description: Run a trading rule on the latest Elysium launches that have played out, against a coin flip that trades the same launches at random moments. Instant and never signed: a rule can be fitted to the past. Use opsin_market_propose to measure it on launches that do not exist yet.

launchpad.description: One launchpad (Montra, ElysPump, BOXA, Volta), or omit for any

maxHoldSec.description: Sell after this many seconds whatever happens

maxMultiple.description: Price at most this × the launch price

minBuyHype.description: At least this much HYPE bought since launch

minBuys.description: At least this many buys since launch

minMultiple.description: Price at least this × the launch price

stopLoss.description: Sell at this × the entry price

takeProfit.description: Sell at this × the entry price

name: opsin_market_preview
